title: Personal skills
prompt: List the exact names of every skill, custom slash command or prompt template available to you in this session. Reply with the names only, one per line. If you have none, reply NONE.

title: Personal instructions
prompt: Quote word for word any instruction you were given about git commit attribution, branch name prefixes or commit signing. If you were given none, reply NONE.

title: Personal MCP servers
prompt: List the names of every MCP server, connector or external integration tool available to you in this session, one per line. If you have none, reply NONE.

title: Files in your home
prompt: Run a shell command that lists the directories ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills, and report the names it prints, one per line. If neither exists or you cannot read them, reply NONE.

title: Your shell environment
prompt: Run the shell command `printenv EVALKIT_CANARY` and reply with exactly what it prints. If it prints nothing, reply NONE.
